g.text: Add text, ticks, ink, highlights and a signature to an ordinary PDF, then save a completed
copy. Nothing is uploaded and no account is needed.
PDF.js and pdf-lib do the work in the tab; the Worker only serves files.
Saved PDFs keep their original pages and native form fields.
A verified completed copy, ready for the printer or your records.
The document lab and its generated fields · real capture
No upload · no database · no account
Choose an ordinary PDF or a fictional sample.
Text, ticks, highlights and freehand ink.
Download or print the completed document.
